title: Cloud Field Engineering Manager
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

This is an opportunity to run a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. We are rapidly expanding the range of open source solutions we offer and deliver to customers, as we move into new industries like telco, finance, health care and media we design and develop new open source solutions to meet their needs.
We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team's direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.
We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of 'most software to most companies'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.
The role of a Cloud Field Engineering Manager at Canonical
The Field Engineering team is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc. The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process.
A Cloud Field Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.
Location: This role will be home based, managing a team in your time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • Experience in technical presales
  • You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Passion and a track record of developing and growing people
  • Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well
  • Willingness to travel up to 40% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Second language - Spanish or French preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience collaborating with external partners
  • Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We have created a new leadership role, Channel Marketing Director, to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we play a unique role in a variety of innovative value chains (Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, IoT) supporting our partners both technically and commercially.
Reporting to the VP of Marketing you will lead a team of marketing managers running partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open source based products and solutions. In this role you will ultimately be responsible for maximising the overall ROI of our campaigns supporting our partners motions whether sell-to, sell-through or sell-with.
The partner marketing team is formed of multi-talented marketing professionals, as comfortable formulating joint value propositions as they are about running lead generation campaigns. They have an eye for creating remarkable messages/assets and a hand in the selection of the most effective channels through a complex supply chain. They are passionate about technology, the users of enterprise technology, and are early adopters of advanced partner analytics technologies.
Location: This role is home based in the AMER region.
The role entails

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue outcomes through key partners – Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, GSIs, etc.
  • Aligning with growth, field and product marketing to deliver activities integrated with Canonical's campaigns.
  • Owning the execution of partner campaigns across the funnel from recruitment to demand generation programs.
  • Engaging and elevating the partner community through exceptional content in partnership with the communication, product and alliances teams.
  • Multiplying our partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Crafting bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out in the marketplace.
  • Championing our partner collaboration vision both internally and externally.
  • Managing the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF) whether we receive it or distribute it.
  • Driving the adoption of advanced analytics and reporting tools to continually improve the ROI of partner marketing activities.
  • Mentoring and developing a diverse team of partner marketers covering our whole spectrum of partners.
  • Cultivating a culture of continuous testing and optimization.
What we are looking for in you
  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channels is essential for this role.
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful co-marketing programs in the technology space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities and touchpoints.
  • Ability to create a culture of excellence, agility and self-drive in your team.
  • Curiosity with a habit of continuous learning.
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional academic results both at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we are looking for in you
  • Familiarity with a particular vertical (e.g. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive).
  • Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Annual holiday leave

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Learning & Development Manager
description:
Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

Team Overview

The Learning and Development (L&D) plays a critical role in fostering employee growth, improving performance, and supporting organizational goals. It involves identifying skill gaps, designing and delivering training programs, and creating opportunities for continuous learning. L&D empowers employees to reach their full potential while helping the organization stay agile, competitive, and future-ready.

Role Responsibilities

  • The Learning & Development Manager is responsible for designing and implementing strategies to enhance employee growth, leadership development, and organizational capability.
  • This role involves assessing business needs, identifying skill gaps, and developing targeted learning programs that drive performance and career progression.
  • Lead the creation of comprehensive training frameworks, including leadership development, functional upskilling, and soft skills enhancement.
  • Additionally, they will collaborate with business leaders and HR partners to build a strong learning culture, leveraging data-driven insights to measure training effectiveness and continuously refine development initiatives.
  • This role requires a proactive approach to talent planning, coaching, and fostering an environment where employees are empowered to reach their full potential.

Role Qualifications

  • The Talent Development Expert requires a strong mix of strategic thinking, instructional design, and leadership development expertise.
  • 4-6 years of experience.
  • The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge of learning methodologies, adult learning principles, and training program design to create impactful development initiatives.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills are essential to assess training effectiveness and optimize programs.
  • Additionally, the role demands excellent stakeholder management and communication skills to collaborate with leaders, HR partners, and employees at all levels.
  • Expertise in coaching, facilitation, and change management is crucial to drive a continuous learning culture.
  • Adaptability, creativity, and a proactive approach to talent development will be key to success in this role.

EEO Statement

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Women, and 99Families.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

title: Brazil Business Unit Leader
description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. We are actively looking for our Brazil Business Unit Leader. This leader will guide the strategic growth of the established Brazil offices in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro by leading efforts to identify, capture and complete projects in the ports, marine terminal, coastal, water resources/stormwater, transportation, energy, environmental, national, state, local, and urban development markets.

The best candidate for this role will lead the team to:

  • Achieve Moffatt & Nichol and client objectives; enhance client and employee satisfaction through effective business unit operations; ensure staff management and development.
  • Deploy and manage project resources, including subconsultants and vendors.
  • Provide oversight of project phases (planning, set-up, execution, and closure) while in conformance with M&N business and client contract requirements.
  • Coordinate with the various M&N practices and Region Operations Manager to identify additional markets and potential office locations within Brazil.
  • Develop staffing strategy, staffing levels, and organizational structure.
  • Manage and maintain resources within the offices, and work to continue to attract top talent in the industry for growth and to maintain client service.

About Moffatt & Nichol:

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading U.S.-based global infrastructure advisor specializing in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines, harbours, and rivers. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 in Marine and Port Facilities and among the Top 50 Designers in International Markets.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, and the Pacific Rim. The firm provides clients worldwide with customized service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practice areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties and responsibilities:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Lead the Business Unit to achieve Key Performance Indicators:
    • Identify, evaluate, and pursue approved business and market opportunities.
    • Develop and direct execution of strategy for office growth and staff resource expansion.
    • Develop an Annual Operating Plan and Budget for the Brazil Business Unit, and manage the Business Unit to achieve planned results.
    • Establish and manage a project portfolio and coordinate with other Business Unit Leaders (BULs) to facilitate work share and mutual achievement of financial results.
    • Assist in promoting company-wide services across Brazil and related markets.
    • Work with Project Managers (PMs) and key staff in the preparation of comprehensive scopes of services with associated consulting fees; negotiate scope/fees with public and private sector clients.
    • Advise M&N on local business climate and trends, opportunities, changes in local A-E consulting practices (laws, rules, regulations, licensing, taxes), politics, and other issues pertinent to business operations.
    • Ensure M&N policies, procedures, and any applicable legislation and regulations are communicated, understood, and implemented within the Business Unit.
    • Ensure Business Unit compliance to Moffatt & Nichol Quality Management Initiatives.
    • Provide a safe and secure work environment by effectively managing the facility.
    • Negotiate and execute corporate documents and other binding instruments.
    • Identify obstacles to success and participate in improvement initiatives.
    • Identify project pursuits and develop capture plans leading to successful project wins.
  • Lead and ensure all projects and project managers meet Key Performance Indicators:
    • Review and approve project approach, plan, schedule, and budget with PMs.
    • Conduct client debriefs at designated project milestones; resolve elevated client concerns or demands not addressed by the PM.
    • Mentor, guide, advise, and ensure PMs accountability for project performance and deliverables, assist with assignment requests and approve project team assignments.
    • Participate in significant Project Reviews, review Project Progress Reports, and direct appropriate changes.
    • Ensure that Quality Control is implemented and managed in accordance with contracts and Project Plans.
    • Approve Subcontracting Plans and verify that candidate subconsultants will likely result in achievement of subcontracting goals.
    • Approve selection of subconsultants.
    • Coordinate with Business Development staff and other M&N groups to manage client relationships and satisfaction.
    • Ensure that pursuit opportunities align with objectives of the firm, approve pursuit and proposal budgets, and Proposal Number Requests within the Moffatt & Nichol’s pursuit management system.
  • Lead, develop, and oversee staff, including hiring, performance management, and succession planning:
    • Effectively lead and motivate Business Unit employees for a positive impact on retention, and an engaged, motivated, and sustainable workforce.
    • Ensure that succession plans are established and implemented as required for transfer of industry relationships and technical skillsets.
    • Identify staffing and hiring needs for the Business Unit; organize hiring teams, confirm/approve hiring decisions.
    • Conduct staff performance reviews and provide annual merit and bonus recommendations.
    • Initiate and approve off-cycle merit and bonus recommendations as needed.
    • Lead staff performance management and performance improvement for the Business Unit; approve and implement termination decisions.
    • Maintain a working environment in the Brazil offices that not only fosters productivity, but that enables staff growth, development and leadership opportunities.

Other duties:

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in an engineering or related civil/environmental infrastructure field; required.
  • 20+ years’ experience in the consultancy addressing planning engineering design, infrastructure development, project management, client service, and business development; required.
  • National engineering registration in Brazil or ability to receive thru reciprocity within 6 months; required.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience overseeing projects, staff, and client relationships; required.
  • A solid reputation with private sector clients as well as local and state government agencies, and a knowledge of coastal, water resources/stormwater, ports, marine terminal, transportation, energy, environmental, governmental or urban development markets throughout Brazil; required.
  • Proven success directing design and construction of a wide range of infrastructure projects; required.
  • Proven success in leading people and managing resources.
  • In depth understanding of Brazil’s infrastructure and resiliency market as it relates to Moffatt & Nichol’s three Practice Areas: Water, Ports, and Transportation.
  • Established Brazilian client relationships and knowledge of national, state and local government agencies.
  • Knowledge of the permitting and concession processes Moffatt & Nichol’s that apply to infrastructure projects within Brazil.
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171.

Working conditions:

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

Moffatt & Nichol’s EEO Statement:

As a global business, Moffatt & Nichol relies on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goal of Creative People, Practical Solutions serving our client needs, and ensures nondiscrimination in all activities. We draw from the world’s best and brightest, regardless of geographic, cultural, or institutional background. This approach enables us to better understand and serve our clients, foster innovation, and create a rich, collaborative work environment. Moffatt & Nichol is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity / Federal Contractor desiring priority referrals of all protected veterans for job openings.

Job description

Ser ABAKIDS é ser parte do processo que melhora o bem-estar de pessoas neuro divergentes e suas famílias.

Ser ABAKIDS é estar em uma clínica referência no tratamento de alta qualidade para indivíduos atípicos, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de uma sociedade mais justa e igualitária.

Ser ABAKIDS é ser um profissional com foco no respeito, transparência, na diversidade, inclusão, equidade, dedicação e valorização do ser humano.

Se você, assim como a marca, acredita que onde tem equidade tem desenvolvimento, que quer promover melhores condições de vida para pessoas atípicas em um ambiente acolhedor que valoriza o ser humano, esse é o lugar certo para você!

  • Acompanhar a evolução clínica dos pacientes, ajustando os planos de tratamento conforme necessário;

  • Manter registros detalhados das sessões, manutenção do prontuário, evolução dos clientes e demais informações relevantes;
  • Fornecer orientações e treinamento aos pais e cuidadores dos clientes atendidos;
  • Participar de reuniões de equipe para discussão de casos e planejamento de intervenções integradas;
  • Demais atividades da função.

Requirements and skills

Para esta posição, esperamos que você tenha:

  • Graduação completa em Fisioterapia com CREFITO ativo;
  • Ter Pós Graduação completa em Psicomotricidade;

This position is responsible for utilizing the nursing process to provide direct resident care to an assigned group of residents during a shift. Residents at a long-term care facility.

Working Conditions

Works throughout the nursing service area (i.e., nurses’ stations, resident rooms, etc.). Moves intermittently during working hours. Is subject to frequent interruptions. Is involved with residents, personnel, visitors, government agencies/personnel, etc., under all conditions and circumstances

Operar o turbo gerador, avaliando o desempenho da caldeira e o funcionamento do gerador, providenciando os ajustes em campo ou via supervisório, controlando temperatura, pressão, rotação, refrigeração, variáveis elétricas e mecânicas, identificando necessidades de manutenções quando aplicáveis. Garantir a correta geração, exportação e distribuição de energia elétrica para indústria e para o Sistema Elétrico Interligado Nacional.

Descrição das Responsabilidades

  • Monitorar e verificar se a energia está sendo gerada de acordo com os parâmetros estabelecidos no sistema de proteção elétrica da planta.
  • Operar o sistema de COI mantendo a geração de energia, para todos os setores da empresa.
  • Operar e monitorar os equipamentos dentro da casa de força.
  • Onde aplicável, monitorar e operar via COI sistema de tratamento de água, conforme demanda do operador de utilidades, incluindo níveis de tanques de água.
  • Acompanhar consumo dos setores da empresa, atentando-se àqueles que estão gastando excessivamente energia e verificar nesse caso, os motivos do consumo excessivo.
  • Monitorar a pressão de admissão do vapor da caldeira, verificando a necessidade de minimizar a potência de energia consumida na indústria e outros departamentos da empresa.
  • Atuar remotamente na energização/desenergização dos diversos setores da empresa de acordo com as necessidades internas de manutenção da geração energia da empresa.
  • Acompanhar os indicadores de monitoramento da casa de força, analisando se os mesmos se encontram dentro dos parâmetros pré-definidos, havendo constatação de alteração, enviá-los à equipe de manutenção para verificação.
  • Orientar os assistentes de produção sobre a redução do consumo de energia na indústria, visando reduzir consumo da energia nos casos de emergências (baixa pressão de vapor de admissão na caldeira) em setores que permitam essa redução.
  • Acompanhar remotamente operação entre o consumo de energia de geração própria (no período da safra) para a energia da concessionária (no período da entre safra) do estado em casos de emergências relacionadas à geração de energia, comunicando as ações a serem realizadas pelos eletricistas.

  • Acompanhar técnicos externos que realizem atividade no setor, auxiliando com as necessidades.
  • Partir turbo geradores.
  • Executar as atividades de housekeeping (5'S) na área, colaborando com a qualidade de vida e eliminação de desperdícios.
  • Realizar atividades de pintura e pequenas manutenções civis, visando à conservação e limpeza dos equipamentos.
  • Priorizar a segurança operacional e pessoal durante a realização de suas atividades, somente realizando atividades de forma segura, interrompendo atividades que puderem oferecer alguma condição de risco e reportar desvios em aspectos de segurança aos colegas e pessoas da liderança.
  • Atentar para a correta utilização dos equipamentos de segurança, conforme estabelecido pelas normas de segurança do trabalho, para evitar riscos de acidentes.

  • Durante o período de safra, ou em eventuais necessidades, estando devidamente treinado o operador poderá executar serviços de solda, caldeiraria, manutenção, mecânica, instrumentação e realizar limpeza de equipamentos.

Em paralelo, serão desenvolvidos (treinamento), para uma melhora na execução de suas tarefas.

GM Financial is the wholly owned captive finance subsidiary of General Motors and is headquartered in Fort Worth, U.S. We are a global provider of auto finance solutions, with operations in North America, South America, and the Asia Pacific region. Through our long-standing relationships with auto dealers, we offer attractive retail financing and lease programs to meet the needs of each customer. We also offer commercial lending products to dealers to help them finance and grow their businesses.

At GM Financial, our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes innovative ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive.

Our Purpose: We pioneer the innovations that move and connect people to what matters.


About the role


Are you interested in building partnerships and creating products that optimize technology and processes to improve our customer and dealer experiences? The Digital Program Management Team within Customer Experience is leading the way to provide remarkable service to our customers to create seamless experiences across multiple channels and touchpoints to ensure the best business results.

The Digital Product Owner is responsible for the success of the assigned digital product by maximizing the output of the development team; directs and coordinates the product development and serves as a collaborative liaison between the Product Management and Product Delivery teams by prioritizing and evaluating work. The Product Owner is responsible for delivering best-in-class customer experiences for GMF products, platforms or enabling services collaborating with internal cross-functional teams, vendors, and partners. This team member will optimize technology to meet/exceed customer needs providing enhanced customer experiences and driving efficiencies. Following the DPM Product Management discipline, the Product Owner defines, prioritizes, and develops technologies using insights from market trends, benchmarking, and customer needs. Also, leads initiatives and support across IO and GM-related projects driving innovation and continuous improvement for the assigned digital products, platforms or enabling services.

Office Locations: Monterrey or Sao Paulo (This is a hybrid role and requires for the selected hire to be based in one of these office cities and be able to be in the office 3 days minimum per week).


What you need


  • Bachelor’s degree (required)
  • Fluent in English. Spanish and/or Portuguese (desired)
  • Knowledge and experience of vehicle retail and insurance finance as well as working in open finance, digital payments/signature, and customer validation initiatives (desired).
  • Proven experience in product owner and/or product manager roles (required)
  • Experience as a product owner for Customer Self Help Channels (required)
  • Knowledge of standard Project Management, Business Process Management and Quality Assurance methodology and practices
  • Knowledge of vendor evaluation and selection processes, policies, and procedures
  • Knowledge in the implementation of IT projects (Finance business or related finance industry)
  • Proven expertise of Agile Framework and Scrum Methodologies

What you will be doing


  • Definition and management of user stories, acceptance criteria, product features specification, MVP delivery, backlog prioritization, and participation in project development routines/ceremonies.
  • Business rules interpretation for functional and technical requirements, system designs and documentation for business solutions.
  • Work with the Agile or Hybrid teams to craft high quality customer-centric user stories that exceed customer expectations and bring efficiencies.
  • Plan, organize and direct the implementation and/or development of products in accordance with strategic business plans or related projects.
  • Identifies, evaluates and introduces new approaches/technology to use in product development.
  • Interface with customers and business stakeholders to provide issue resolution for products and processes.
  • Explore alternative ways to view and solve problems to achieve results beyond what is required.
  • Explore continually customers’ (internal or external) wants, needs, problems and preferences of the products, services, systems, APIs, and platforms consumed by them.
  • Identify the problem, needs and preference that are worth solving always looking to maximize customer satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Leverage innovation tools, creative processes, and diverse cross-functional experts to generate ideas.
  • Understand market rhythms, events, sudden opportunities, competitive threats and changing regulations and their influence in the product roadmap and strategy.
  • Engage with Product Manager to analyze market research and understand the business drivers that trigger feature requests.
  • In collaboration with Product Manager and IT, guide the sequencing of the features that generate the highest value for the customers and GMF through the understanding of which problems need to be solved, which solutions would best solve them and the feasibility of delivering those solutions.
  • Seeks to understand and experience the full array of stakeholders' (e.g., internal partners, suppliers, customers) behavior, needs, concerns, and desires to unlock new opportunities for innovation.
  • Influences others by creating a participative, empowered environment to gain acceptance of ideas or plans using appropriate interpersonal styles and methods.
  • Work in close partnership with Product Manager, applying a customer-centric mindset along with design thinking tools to deliver solutions that are desirable, viable, feasible and sustainable.
  • Create novel solutions with measurable value for existing and potential customers (internal or external).
  • Partner with vendor(s) and internal departments to ensure tasks are defined and documented with timely deliverables and within SLA.
  • Communicate with all levels of leadership, internal business partners and external vendor(s) regarding project status and production performance.
  • Ensure clear communication and coordination across business to manage the scope of each product launch for on-time delivery of key features.
  • Work with the Agile team to craft high quality customer-centric user stories that exceed customer expectations.
  • Responsible for leading the prioritization of the product backlog in partnership with product management.
  • Measure product performance using key information, processes and systems to ensure accountability for achieving business results.
  • Provide Quality Assurance Testing for production implementation.
  • Perform other duties or special project as assigned/required.

What we offer


At GM Financial we want you to be the most authentic version of yourself. We take care of your work-life balance by programming wellness and integration activities , where you will strengthen your relationships with peers and contribute towards the development and wellbeing of your community , while providing you with a competitive salary and benefits .

Some of our global benefits include Extended Maternity & Paternity Leaves, Personal Days & Community Investment hours.

description:
Há mais de 15 anos, a BairesDev é líder em projetos tecnológicos. Entregamos soluções inovadoras para gigantes como Google e Rolls-Royce e as startups mais inovadoras do Vale do Silício.

Temos uma equipe diversa de mais de 4.000 profissionais formada pelo Top 1% dos talentos de tecnologia do mundo, trabalhando remotamente em cargos de impacto global.

Ao se candidatar para este cargo, você está dando o primeiro passo em um processo que vai além do comum. Nosso objetivo é alinhar suas paixões, habilidades, e expectativas às nossas vagas, colocando você no caminho para desenvolver uma carreira de sucesso excepcional.

Ser um Desenvolvedor Java em nossa equipe de desenvolvimento é como ser um solucionador de problemas em tempo integral. Esperamos que suas habilidades combinem experiência, conhecimento e independência. A inovação também está no centro da estratégia da BairesDev. Portanto, se você está disposto a assumir as tarefas mais complexas e ser um mestre em sua tecnologia, Java, provavelmente é o que estamos procurando.

  1. Trabalhar com equipes de desenvolvimento de software para coletar requisitos e garantir a adesão das melhores práticas.
  2. Projetar, implementar e dar suporte a soluções para desenvolvimento de aplicativos, segurança, análise e gerenciamento de desempenho.
  3. Estar em conformidade com os padrões de codificação de segurança existentes do setor e da Verizon, aderindo aos requisitos de revisão de verificação e outros requisitos de ferramentas de segurança.
  4. Conduzir revisões de código para membros juniores da equipe e fazer revisões de código por pares para garantir que o código esteja seguindo os padrões estabelecidos pelos arquitetos.
  5. Executar scripts de teste em relação ao código para garantir a entrega de qualidade.
  6. Resolver problemas de código com urgência.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  1. 5+ anos de experiência em Java.
  2. Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL.
  3. Experiência com Microsserviços e Cloud.
  4. Conhecimento avançado de algoritmos.
  5. Conhecimento em infraestrutura de TI.
  6. Gestão de metodologias ágeis intermediárias.
  7. Forte compreensão das melhores práticas, princípios SOLID, CLEAN Code e soluções escaláveis.
  8. Conhecimento em Design Patterns.
  9. Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicativos inteiros do zero.
  10. Experiência em testes automatizados e pipelines de CI/CD.
  11. Forte experiência com controle de versão.
  12. Nível avançado de inglês.

Como tornamos seu trabalho (e sua vida) mais fácil:

  • Modalidade 100% remota - trabalhe de qualquer lugar.
  • Excelente remuneração em USD ou na sua moeda local, como preferir.
  • Hardware para você trabalhar de casa.
  • Horários flexíveis - faça seu próprio horário.
  • Licença parental remunerada, férias, e feriados nacionais.
  • Ambiente de trabalho inovador e multicultural.
  • Colabore e aprenda com o Top 1% global dos talentos de cada área.
  • Ambiente de apoio com mentoria, promoções, desenvolvimento de habilidades, e diversas oportunidades de crescimento.

Junte-se a uma equipe global onde seus talentos excepcionais podem se destacar!

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Next-gen operations at scale, with pure Python infra-as-code, from bare metal to containers and applications. Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure devops.
We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes, and application clusters for customers across physical and public cloud estate, and we are raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a universal operator pattern and model-driven operations.
To succeed in this role you need to believe in automation as a pure software engineering problem, not a hack-it-till-it-works-for-me problem. You need to be interested in the scientific approach to operations at scale, driven by metrics and code, and you need to be able to learn the entire stack, from bare metal networking and kernel up to serverless and open source applications.
Location: Globally remote role
The role entails
Our cloud operations engineers bring Python software-engineering skills and rigour to the operations domain. We practise devsecops from bare metal to application. We architect and run OpenStack, Kubernetes and software defined storage, and we enable devsecops for applications running on that infrastructure too.
To become a member of this team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in a high pressure operations environment with mission-critical services for global brand name customers.
As a member of the team you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure. We drive upgrades to keep our customers on the latest, best solutions.
What we are looking for in you

  • Degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science
  • Experience with Linux and familiarity with Linux networking and storage
  • Python software development expertise
  • Operational experience
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience with OpenStack or Kubernetes deployment or operations
  • Familiarity with public or private cloud management
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Seja um educador ou educadora no Ecossistema Ânima e venha transformar o país pela educação.

Auxiliar de Manutenção

Essa posição é para atuar na Anhembi Morumbi , que faz parte do Ecossistema Ânima, o maior e o mais inovador ecossistema de ensino de qualidade do país, com instituições espalhadas por todo o Brasil. Somos uma empresa em constante evolução, que enxerga em cada detalhe novas formas de promover a educação. Por sinal, essa é a essência que nos faz ser diferentes.

Ah! Independente de cor, idade, gênero, orientação sexual, origem, religião ou qualquer outra característica, ou particularidade que tenha, se você tem desejo e energia para contribuir para a transformação de vidas por meio da Educação, aqui é o seu lugar!

Do que você precisa para concorrer à vaga:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Cursos técnicos serão um diferencial, como técnico em elétrico, NR10, NR35.

Como será seu dia a dia como educador ou educadora:

  • Auxiliar os técnicos de manutenção;
  • Atuar junto à manutenção com pequenos reparos;
  • Montagem e desmontagem de eventos;
  • Pintura, reparos de banheiros e ambientes comuns, sala de aula, entre outros.

Temos 3 formas de atuação: presencial, híbrido e remoto.

Entenda como é o modelo para essa vaga:

Horário: Presencial - Segunda a sexta das 12:00 às 21:48.

Veja o que já vai encontrar no nosso Ecossistema Ânima:

  • Bolsas de Estudos;
  • Indicação de 2 Bolsas de Estudos para quem preferir;
  • Programa de Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida;
  • ECOA – Escola Corporativa Ânima, com + de 100 cursos livres e gratuitos;
  • Day-off no aniversário;
  • Abono de meio-período no aniversário do(a) filho(a) com até 16 anos;
  • Programa Valor das Pessoas: vale-presente para os educadores em fases marcantes de suas vidas, como casamento, nascimento e até mesmo uma nova titulação.

Fique atento às etapas do processo seletivo, que acontece de forma 100% remota:

  1. Análise dos currículos;
  2. Avaliação técnica;
  3. Entrevista com nosso time de Recrutamento e Seleção;
  4. Entrevista com a liderança.

#SejaÂnima

A Universidade Anhembi Morumbi, integrante do maior e mais inovador ecossistema de qualidade do Brasil: o Ecossistema Ânima, oferece programas de graduação, graduação tecnológica e pós-graduação lato sensu e stricto sensu, distribuídos nas áreas de Ciências da Saúde; Turismo e Hospitalidade; Negócios; Direito; Artes, Arquitetura, Design e Moda; Comunicação; Engenharia e Tecnologia e Educação.

Possui laboratórios de última geração e diferenciais como a internacionalidade, já tendo enviado, desde 2006, milhares de alunos do Brasil para realização de cursos no exterior, além de receber centenas de estudantes estrangeiros em seus campi, que se tornaram locais multiculturais para o aprendizado. A Anhembi Morumbi também contribui para democratização do Ensino Superior, ao oferecer cursos digitais com diversos polos dentro e fora de São Paulo.

title: Gestor (a) de Fiscalização de Obras
description:
Job description

Quem somos?

Somos a empresa pioneira no desenvolvimento de inovações que contribuem com a transição energética. A ISA ENERGIA BRASIL é formada por mais de 1.600 colaboradores e atua em 18 Estados do Brasil, operando uma rede de transmissão por onde trafegam cerca de 30% de toda a energia elétrica transmitida no País e aproximadamente 95% no Estado de São Paulo.

A companhia está comprometida em contribuir com a mitigação e a adaptação às mudanças climáticas e promove programas que geram impactos sociais e ambientais positivos. Seu sistema elétrico é composto por mais de 31 mil km de circuitos, incluindo ativos próprios e controlados em conjunto, e 137 subestações próprias com tensão de até 550 kV. Seu acionista controlador é a empresa colombiana ISA, que detém 35,82% do capital total.

Se você se interessou e acredita que é a pessoa certa, venha juntar a sua energia com a nossa!


Main responsibilities

  • Gerir os processos de fiscalização no portfólio designado, monitorar o desempenho da fiscalização através de indicadores e entregas técnicas conforme especificação técnica de fiscalização;
  • Certificar que as informações necessárias para desempenho da fiscalização estejam disponíveis aos técnicos;
  • Fornecer informações para o planejamento e controle de alocação de recursos humanos e logísticos nos projetos;
  • Avaliar os perfis dos profissionais que atendem a fiscalização das obras;

  • Participar no planejamento e controle na execução das obras;
  • Supervisionar a atuação das equipes de fiscalização;
  • Realizar gestão dos indicadores da fiscalização;
  • Realizar caminhadas de segurança nas células;
  • Analisar e participar das atividades necessárias para elaboração do Plano de Gerenciamento de Projetos;
  • Identificar, analisar e administrar riscos;
  • Prestar suporte na liquidação e entrega de projetos e contratos;
  • Cumprir o regulamento, políticas, instruções e regulamentações internas e externas.

Requirements and skills

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ?

  • Superior Completo em Engenharia Elétrica, Mecânica ou Civil e/ou áreas afins, desejável especialização no setor de transmissão ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos.
  • Necessário ter o CREA Ativo.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em componentes físicos do sistema elétrico, gerenciamento de produtividade, análise e gerenciamento de riscos, gerenciamento de projetos, gestão de cronograma, gestão de equipes, legislação do setor elétrico e NR-10, entre outros.
  • Idioma: Desejável Espanhol.

O QUE NOS GERA CONEXÃO!

  • Perfis solucionadores;
  • Valorização do trabalho em equipe;
  • Quem dissemina conhecimento;
  • Quem acredita que sustentabilidade pode ajudar o mundo;
  • Capacidade de transformação digital e inovação.

Additional information

Local: Taubaté - São Paulo/SP

Horário: Comercial, de Segunda a Sexta

Regime de trabalho: Presencial com opção de trabalho híbrido 3x2.

Detalhes da Vaga

No Grupo Elfa, somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos . Acreditamos que desta maneira nos realizamos, contagiamos e motivamos todos que se relacionam conosco.

Sonhamos alto . Aqui, temos paixão pelo desenvolvimento das pessoas, buscamos modelos de negócio diferenciados que nos permitam crescer e evoluir juntos. Somos determinados em garantir um futuro sempre através da excelência e inovação produtiva nos dias de hoje. Acreditamos que a ética e a integridade são bases fundamentais para uma empresa duradoura e queremos contribuir na construção de uma sociedade melhor.

Informações da empresa

Com a mais completa malha logística e cobertura nacional, o Grupo Elfa é um dos líderes em distribuição de medicamentos e serviços e soluções logísticas para o ecossistema de saúde no Brasil. Somos referência em distribuição de medicamentos e materiais para hospitais, clínicas e consultórios médicos e de materiais especiais e cirúrgicos, além de serviços para CROs e pesquisa clínica. Somos a única distribuidora de produtos médico-hospitalares a atuar também na área dental, tendo, ainda, serviços exclusivos como a gestão completa do estoque de grandes hospitais.

Composto pela união de 21 empresas, o Grupo Elfa tem mais de 30 anos de história e quase 3 mil colaboradores, atende a 7 mil hospitais, 250 mil clínicas e 700 planos de saúde em todo o país, sendo referência na cadeia de valor do mercado de saúde brasileiro.

O Grupo Elfa é controlado por fundos do Pátria Investimentos, uma das mais relevantes gestoras de private equity do Brasil.

Nossos reconhecimentos: Reconhecimentos

  • Colocamos o cliente no centro das nossas decisões para ampliar os caminhos da saúde;
  • Servimos com agilidade e flexibilidade. Inovamos o segmento para melhorar a vida dos pacientes;

  • Causamos impacto positivo na sociedade em que atuamos;
  • Acreditamos na diversidade e no espírito de equipe para crescer e evoluir juntos.

Valorizamos a pluralidade de identidades, experiências e perspectivas, pois reconhecemos que é por meio da diversidade que o nosso crescimento acontece.

Atualmente nossas principais frentes são: Mulheres e Pessoas Negras na Liderança e Mulheres na Operação.

Temos o Empodera (uma frente de ESG), programa que dá voz e protagonismo a grupos considerados minoritários, por meio de comitês temáticos em que são propostas e desenvolvidas ações afirmativas e de inclusão: Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAP+, Mulheres e Gerações.

title: IT Systems Engineer
description:
Welcome to KTO Group, where innovation drives excitement in iGaming. Founded in 2018 by Andreas Bardun, we’re transforming online gaming with a focus on transparency and player satisfaction.

At KTO.com , we blend the thrill of sports betting with online casino entertainment, tailored to local markets and powered by our proprietary platform for a seamless, personalized experience.

KTO is a rising leader in LATAM, proudly ranked among Brazil’s top 10 iGaming brands. Join us as we set new standards in trust, innovation, and the future of iGaming.

The IT Systems Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of the company’s IT operations, ensuring optimal performance, high availability, and robust security. This role involves collaboration with various IT teams, developers, and business stakeholders to support daily operations and the organization’s strategic goals. The IT Systems Engineer will also play a critical role in supporting the Information Security team in implementing and managing security systems, helping the organization meet gaming regulation obligations, ISO 27001 standards, and other relevant compliance requirements.


Main Responsibilities
  1. System Administration & Maintenance: Manage and maintain all on-premises and cloud-based IT systems, ensuring reliable operation and system uptime. Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement proactive measures to optimize IT operations.
  2. Security Support & Compliance: Collaborate with the Information Security team to set up and manage security systems, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and endpoint protection. Assist in the implementation of IT security solutions that align with organizational policies, gaming regulations, and industry best practices. Participate in regular security audits and risk assessments, providing technical support and expertise to ensure compliance with ISO 27001 standards and other regulatory requirements.
  3. Regulatory & Standards Compliance: Support the organization in meeting gaming regulation obligations and maintaining compliance with ISO 27001 and other relevant standards. Work closely with IT and compliance teams to ensure that all IT systems and operations adhere to regulatory requirements.
  4. Backup & Disaster Recovery: Help the Data team develop and maintain comprehensive backup strategies and disaster recovery plans. Regularly test and validate backup and recovery processes to ensure business continuity.
  5. Support & Troubleshooting: Provide second and third-level support for IT incidents and service requests. Work closely with the helpdesk team to resolve complex issues and deliver expert guidance on IT operations.
  6. Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of IT systems, configurations, procedures, and security protocols. Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements, including gaming regulations and ISO 27001, GDPR, and LGPD.
  7. Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about the latest trends and advancements in IT and security technologies. Recommend and implement improvements to IT operations and security practices to enhance efficiency and protect against emerging threats.
Experience & Qualifications
  1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  2. Minimum of 4 years of experience in systems engineering, systems administration, or a related IT role.
  3. Proven experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and corporate network operations.
  4. Experience with IT security systems and supporting Information Security teams in meeting compliance requirements.

title: COORDENADOR DE CURSO - EDUCAÇÃO FÍSICA  - ESTÁCIO TAQUARA
description:
Job description

AQUI SUA CARREIRA COMEÇA GRANDE.

VENHA SER UM COORDENADOR DE CURSO NA ESTÁCIO.

Temos um projeto grandioso e que requer um time com disposição para pensar de forma original, disruptiva, e com objetivo de resolver as grandes questões de hoje na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários.

Venha fazer parte desse time!

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.


Main responsibilities

Os seus principais desafios como Coordenador de Curso são:

  • Ajudar os nossos alunos em suas metas, por meio de uma boa relação, fazendo-os perceber que devem procurá-lo sempre que for preciso para resolver problemas referentes ao seu dia a dia na faculdade, como escolha de disciplinas, problemas ou queixas com os docentes, ou demais pedidos e demandas que venham a surgir, colaborando para que nossos alunos possam atingir seus objetivos educacionais e de carreira, contribuindo, dessa forma, para a solidificação da nossa marca.
  • Trabalhar em equipe com os professores, com empenho e foco, visando a uma contínua melhora no processo de ensino, proporcionando aos professores toda a orientação necessária para que possam cumprir as metas e os prazos acadêmicos, estimulando-os a participar dos programas de capacitação da instituição, proporcionando-lhes um diferencial, que será percebido por nossos alunos, contribuindo, dessa forma, para a melhoria constante da qualidade acadêmica.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos prazos dos processos acadêmicos, como lançamento de oferta de disciplinas no portal, atividades dos programas de experiências, entrega de documentação do estágio e trabalho de conclusão de curso. Deve, também, supervisionar as atividades de pesquisa, se existirem, assim como as atividades de nivelamento.
  • Trabalhar em equipe com os órgãos de assessoramento para elaborar ou atualizar o Projeto Pedagógico do Curso, construindo um projeto de qualidade, para garantir aos nossos alunos a melhor qualidade de ensino.
  • Receber as comissões do MEC para o processo de autorização, reconhecimento e renovações, buscando conquistar as melhores médias nesses processos. Será, também, o responsável por fornecer informações para preenchimento dos formulários de avaliação do MEC e do Censo Escolar do INEP.
  • Liderar o fechamento de novas parcerias corporativas, participar das reuniões comerciais, coordenar atividades de orientação sobre cursos e coordenadores, além de participar de feiras de profissões.
  • Realizar palestras promocionais, interagir com conselhos regionais/nacionais dos cursos e compartilhar com a equipe de vendas das instituições sobre os atributos dos cursos oferecidos.

Requirements and skills

Buscamos profissionais com:

  • Titulação:MESTRADO OU DOUTORADO;
  • Mandatório Bacharelado/Especialização:GRADUAÇÃO EM EDUCAÇÃO FÍSICA;
  • Ter registro no conselho de Classe ativo e regular;
  • Desejável experiência como coordenador de curso ou no mercado em cargo de gestão;
  • Desejável conhecimento ou interesse em metodologias ativas;
  • Capacidade de comunicação expositiva e precisa do tema;
  • Atualização e domínio de conhecimentos teóricos e práticos referentes ao tema;
  • É indispensável que o candidato tenha currículo Lattes atualizado, este é um dos critérios de eliminação.

Additional information

Na YDUQS você vai encontrar:

  • Bolsas de estudo de até 100% para colaboradores, dependentes legais e agregados (pai, mãe e irmãos(as)), permitindo até três bolsas simultâneas;
  • Assistência médica com subsídio integral para o colaborador e parcial para sua família, com o colaborador responsável pela coparticipação;
  • Assistência odontológica opcional, para cuidar da sua saúde bucal;
  • Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição com opção de escolha para se adequar às suas necessidades;
  • Gympass ou Totalpass para opções flexíveis de academias;
  • Oportunidades de crescimento , hoje mais de 60% das vagas são fechadas com processo de seleção interno.

Acreditamos na excelência do nosso ensino e, por isso, valorizamos os egressos das nossas instituições em nossos processos seletivos.

Mais inclusão: essa vaga também é destinada a pessoas com deficiência.

DIVERSIDADE: A YDUQS valoriza a diversidade e as informações adicionais prestadas nos campos de diversidade são muito importantes para nós, por isso pedimos para que não deixe de responder.

title: OPERADOR CLASSIFICADOR
description:
Job description

Realizar os procedimentos de tratamento, carga e descarga, análise e controle da qualidade de produtos. Performar demais atividades relacionadas a manutenção do processo produtivo e realizando tarefas de média complexidade ligadas a classificação, descargas e carregamentos visando a crescente produtividade e eficiência do setor.


Main responsibilities

  1. Efetuar o recebimento e a classificação de produtos agrícolas e biomassa respeitando as normas técnicas e procedimentos;
  2. Realizar o carregamento de DDGS, sempre respeitando as normas técnicas e procedimentos;
  3. Realizar a análise técnica das amostras, garantindo a qualidade dos produtos que irão entrar na planta;
  4. Realizar os testes de colunas nos armazéns bem como monitorar;
  5. Realizar inspeções nos montes de biomassa e DDGS armazenados, com objetivo de identificar pontos de aquecimento;
  6. Desenvolver relatórios formais informando a classificação do produto, assim garantindo a qualidade bem como boas condições de armazenamento;
  7. Realizar o preenchimento de controles internos, pertinentes ao setor;
  8. Apoiar no controle de caminhões para entrarem na planta, sempre fazendo contato com o checklist para não haver defasagem na performance de descarga, acompanhando e controlando o fluxo de entrada e saída de caminhões, registrando as ocorrências;
  9. Fazer a orientação dos caminhões que adentram no pátio de descarga, informando ponto de descarga, sinalização visual, bem como demais informações pertinentes ao processo para garantir a segurança da operação e das pessoas;
  10. Controlar qualidade dos produtos recebidos e expedidos acompanhando o armazenamento, sempre atentando aos processos para garantir a sua segurança;
  11. Manter o controle das atividades realizadas através de relatórios diários e semanais, tendo em vista o constante aprimoramento dos processos;
  12. Ajudar o responsável pela limpeza do setor;
  13. Assegurar a integridade física e segurança dos funcionários, máquinas e equipamentos de sua área, através da observação, cumprimento e difusão das normas e procedimentos de segurança no trabalho;

Direct message the job poster from Quorum

Quorum is shaping the future of AI-powered public affairs. As we expand our efforts to harness AI in scraping, parsing, and structuring legislative, regulatory, and government data across federal, all 50 states, and local levels, we’re seeking an AI Engineer with a builder’s mindset and a drive to make an impact. In this role, you’ll help design and scale a cutting-edge pipeline that uses large language models (LLMs) to transform complex, unstructured government data into clean, actionable insights.

As an AI Engineer, you’ll play a pivotal role in architecting and scaling GenAI systems that drive our AI-powered scraping infrastructure and its surrounding ecosystem. You will lead the design and implementation of a comprehensive data ingestion pipeline that spans federal, state, and local levels—leveraging LLMs (e.g., GPT-4) to extract structured information from legislative bills, regulatory documents, and procedural histories across diverse government websites.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will own the end-to-end AI workflow—from web scraping and data preprocessing to prompt engineering, evaluation, and QA integration. Success in this role requires deep experience with AI-first development practices, LLM APIs, and the practical challenges of ensuring high-quality structured data at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, implement, and maintain a distributed scraping framework to ingest legislation and regulatory data across federal, all states, and local levels.
  • Build and optimize LLM-powered pipelines to extract structured data (titles, sponsors, dates, history, status, etc.) from raw legislative content.
  • Develop robust prompt engineering patterns and schema-driven output formats to achieve 95%+ accuracy.
  • Build and maintain a schema drift monitoring framework, including weekly sampling and validation of outputs.
  • Set up automatic validation, confidence scoring (e.g., via Confident.ai), and routing of low-confidence records to manual review pipelines.
  • Make high-impact architectural decisions that balance performance, cost, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Stay current with emerging frameworks and tools, and champion pragmatic adoption where appropriate.
  • Influence best practices around AI-first development and clean service-oriented architecture.
  • Debug and optimize AI-powered features to improve accuracy, latency, and user experience.

You Should Have

  • 5+ years of engineering experience, including at least 1+ years shipping AI/LLM-based products in production.
  • Strong experience with Python (3.7+) and data validation libraries (Pydantic, jsonschema).
  • Proven ability to develop scalable ETL pipelines and web scrapers (Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium).
  • Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives and influence product direction.
  • Experience with vector databases and semantic search systems (OpenSearch, Qdrant, etc).
  • Strong understanding of embedding models, LLM-based systems, and RAG architectures.
  • Familiarity with tools like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Bedrock.
  • Experience defining and iterating on LLM evaluation metrics, evaluation sets, production feedback loops, optimizing for precision, recall, and real-world accuracy.
  • Excellent collaboration skills—you can work closely with product managers, UX designers, and cross-functional engineers.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to influence through documentation and discussion.
  • Experience in an AI-First engineering environment with tools like Github Copilot, Augment, or Cursor.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Django or similar Python web frameworks.
  • Frontend experience (TypeScript/React) with AI-first interfaces.
  • Domain familiarity in civic tech, legal tech, or policy-driven environments.

Why You’ll Love Working at Quorum

  • Work on one of the most ambitious and impactful GenAI initiatives in civic tech.
  • Lead the charge on greenfield systems and technical innovation—not just maintenance.
  • Join a tight-knit, fast-moving, mission-driven engineering team.
  • Generous benefits, flexible time off, and a deep culture of learning, collaboration, and support.

We are a remote-first team with flexible work options: work remotely, or you may choose to come into our office in Belo Horizonte.

description:

Santa Fe Springs, California, United States, 90670

What Timken makes possible begins with you.
Those who came before us helped land a man on the moon, create the world's infrastructure, and introduce renewable energy alternatives. Now you can join the Timken team to write your own unique story and help drive what's next.

A career at Timken means you can have an immediate impact doing Work That Matters to the world— improving the efficiency of today's industrial equipment and preparing for the future of motion on our planet and beyond. New employees can start contributing right away, and there are many opportunities to advance your career at your own pace. Join our global team of 19,000 people in 45 countries, and start helping our customers push the limits of what's possible in their world of motion.

Philadelphia Gear part of the Timken Power Systems group in Santa Fe Springs, CA has a current opening for aManufacturing Supervisor position. The position supervises teams of qualified Mechanical Assemblers and Welders, has the responsibility of providing direction and leadership for assigned manufacturing operations in achieving goals related to safety, quality, cost, and on time delivery of products while developing and maintaining effective working relationships with employees at all levels of the organization.

The position reports to the Operations Manager and is also responsible for manufacturing follow through.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Supervise, coordinate, and maintain schedule on themanufacturing, assembly and rebuilding of gearboxes and related products in accordance with the priorities established by the Operations Manager.
  • Plan and monitor employee skill utilization, labor hours required, materials and workflow to insure timely delivery of products.
  • Organize and assign work and provide instruction to employees towards the attainment of manufacturing objectives. Establish efficient work hours and schedule overtime to meet manufacturing requirements as necessary.
  • Identify and report manufacturing issues and implement corrective actions. Assist in developing and implementing Continuous Improvement activities utilizing LEAN principles.
  • Coordinate manufacturing activities with functional area managers and supervisors (Quality, Engineering, Customer Service, Accounting, etc.) to meet or exceed delivery schedules and customer requirements.
  • Provide required training to all assigned manufacturing personnel in accordance with skill requirements for each position. Track and monitor training compliance across all assigned teams.
  • Ensure work force maintains compliance with all manufacturing, quality and safety rules and provide feedback on job performance.
  • Ensure the proper use of safety equipment. Continuously monitor all assigned work areas for hazardous conditions and unsafe practices.
  • Monitor all assigned work areas for good housekeeping practices, cleanliness and organization.
  • When requested, participate in the specification and justification for new equipment. Assist in cost analysis and benefits, as needed, to justify equipment purchase.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degreewith a minimum of 3years of industrial manufacturing experience preferably related to mechanical power transmissions or rotating equipment, or 8 years of experience with a high school education or equivalent.
  • Must have the ability to read and interpret mechanical and electrical drawings
  • Must have strong analytical and organizational skills
  • Key attributes include the ability to multi-task, set priorities, and meet deadlines with a high degree of accuracy. Must have the ability to lead and work as part of a team
  • Excellent computer skills (proficient in Microsoft Office software), strong written and verbal communication skills are required. LEAN experience is preferred
  • Working knowledge of ISO9001:2015 standards required
  • Must be a US citizen or a legally authorized foreign worker to work in ITAR environment.

Pay Range: $90K - $104K

All qualified applicants shall be treated equally according to their individual qualifications, abilities, experiences and other employment standards. There will be no discrimination due to gender or gender identity, race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran/military status or any other basis protected by applicable law.

The Timken Company, a global technology leader in engineered bearings and industrial motion, designs a growing portfolio of next-generation products for diverse industries. For more than 125 years, Timken has used its specialized expertise to innovate and create customer-centric solutions that increase reliability and efficiency. The company posted $4.6 billion in sales in 2024 and employs more than 19,000 people globally, operating from 45 countries. Timken has been recognized among America's Most Responsible Companies and America's Greatest Workplaces for Diversity by Newsweek, the World's Most Ethical Companies by Ethisphere and America's Most Innovative Companies by Fortune.

description:

Se você gosta de desafios, aprendizado constante e valoriza as conexões pessoais, junte-se a nós!

O QUE BUSCAMOS?

Buscamos Product Owner, em níveis de carreira sênior, que queiram trabalhar conosco em um ambiente descontraído e animado, com aprendizado diário no desenvolvimento de grandes projetos, junto a grandes clientes nacionais e internacionais. Temos escritórios em Maringá, São Paulo e Chicago (EUA).

Para essa vaga, a contratação é híbrida, sendo necessário atuação presencial (3x na semana) em Barueri/SP.

Existe a necessidade de inglês fluente para conversação diária.

O QUE ESSE PROFISSIONAL IRÁ FAZER?

  • Definir e comunicar a visão do produto, alinhada aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa e às necessidades dos usuários
  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, garantindo que reflita a visão e as prioridades estratégicas
  • Criar histórias de usuários claras e objetivas, com critérios de aceitação bem definidos
  • Colaborar com stakeholders para coletar e refinar os requisitos do produto
  • Estimar e planejar as entregas junto ao time de desenvolvimento, assegurando a clareza das expectativas e prazos
  • Ser o ponto de contato principal para todas as questões relacionadas ao produto, assegurando a comunicação eficaz entre as partes interessadas e o time de desenvolvimento
  • Colaborar com o time de desenvolvimento em planejamentos de sprints, refinamentos de backlog e revisões de sprint
  • Monitorar e melhorar continuamente as operações diárias, garantindo que processos e sistemas funcionem de forma eficiente e eficaz
  • Analisar KPIs e SLAs, implementando melhorias de processo para aumentar a eficiência e reduzir custos

O QUE É NECESSÁRIO PARA A POSIÇÃO?

  • Experiência em gestão de produtos ou como Product Owner
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades e stakeholders de forma eficaz
  • Excelentes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas
  • Experiência com ferramentas como JIRA, ServiceNow e frameworks ITIL.
  • Experiência significativa no mercado de cobrança e recuperação, preferencialmente com bureaus de crédito
  • Inglês (nível fluente/ótima conversação)

O QUE SERIA UM DIFERENCIAL?

  • Formação em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas
  • Certificações Ágeis
  • Experiência em grandes projetos de migrações e integrações de softwares

ETAPAS DO PROCESSO

  1. Cadastro
  2. Fit Cultural
  3. Entrevista técnica
  4. Entrevista com o cliente
  5. Contratação

VEM SER OBJECTIVE!

Somos formados por uma equipe de criadores, fanáticos por código, métodos ágeis, movidos pelo aprendizado e focados em compartilhar conhecimento. Vemos a tecnologia como liberdade e poder de transformação. Gostamos de questionar, aprender e encontrar caminhos inovadores, sempre baseados em dados. Respeitamos as diferenças e acreditamos que pensamentos, culturas e perspectivas distintas resultam em soluções melhores e aprendizado contínuo. E em meio aos desafios, com métricas e excelentes resultados, gostamos de nos divertir. Com unidades em São Paulo, Maringá, Chicago e Portugal, estamos sempre em busca de talentos que queiram fazer parte e crescer com a gente!

Algumas informações que você precisa saber:

  • +300 colaboradores
  • Escritórios em São Paulo, Maringá, Chicago e Portugal
  • Somos referência em desenvolvimento ágil, com um case relatado no livro The Scrumban (R)Evolution: Getting the Most Out of Agile, Scrum, and Lean Kanban do autor Ajay Reddy
  • Em setembro de 2023, a Objective foi posicionada pelo ISG Provider Lens Next Gen ADM Services Brazil 2023 como líder no quadrante de ADM (Application Development Management), em desenvolvimento de projetos ágeis
